raw_text: Indian Navy tracked a Chinese nuclear attack submarine in the Bay of Bengal for 72 hours. Type 093A Shang-class. Used P-8I Poseidon and INS Kadmatt. This is a serious ASW operation and shows that PLAN SSNs are now operating regularly in the Indian Ocean. India's Andaman & Nicobar Command is going to become increasingly critical.
clean_text: Indian Navy tracked PLAN Type 093A SSN for 72 hours in Bay of Bengal. P-8I and INS Kadmatt deployed. PLAN SSNs now regularly operating in Indian Ocean.
